segments.oily: A couple of reviewers with oily or previously oily skin found the formula recommended for and suited to oily skin, or noted their skin had shifted from oily/acne-prone to dehydrated and now responds well to it.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin, including one in a dry climate and one with dry, mature skin, report the ampoule visibly relieves dryness and keeps skin hydrated for hours after application.
segments.combination: One reviewer, describing her own skin as neutral, notes the lightweight, non-greasy formula as well suited to oily or combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, redness or burning, with some specifically contrasting it favorably to other salmon-DNA serums that did irritate them.
segments.normal: One reviewer with neutral (normal) skin reports a firming, bouncy finish and deep nourishment without any greasiness.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin report firmer, more hydrated skin and, in some cases, a brighter and more youthful look; one reviewer in her fifties saw smoother skin but no improvement in sagging or elasticity after more than two months of daily use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers targeting fine lines, wrinkles, firmness and sagging report firmer, smoother, plumper-looking skin, in some cases within days, and a few note visibly softer neck lines or wrinkles after several weeks; one reviewer in her fifties, however, saw no improvement in sagging or elasticity despite two months of daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report deep, lasting hydration and softer, smoother skin after use, including in dry climates; no reviewer reports the product itself causing dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report calmer skin and no new irritation, including one whose mask-related redness and allergic reaction cleared overnight and another who found it gentler than a comparable salmon-DNA serum that had caused her redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a compromised skin barrier, from over-moisturizing or product overuse, report it feeling significantly stronger and more resilient within about two weeks of use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a visible reduction in dark spots, melasma or uneven tone after several weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: some reviewers say it kept their skin free of breakouts even during periods they'd normally break out, while one reviewer developed new red papules and increased pimples after starting to use it.
concerns.oiliness: Material is limited, but a couple of reviewers describe the lightweight, non-greasy formula as well suited to oily skin without describing a specific oil-control effect.

aspects.libelle: Glass ampoules arrive broken or leaking
Syringe-style applicator awkward or prone to jamming
Considered expensive for the amount of product
Three-bottle set seen as good value

extraits.titre: Had bad reaction on my skin
extraits.texte: Seeing reviews and recommendations ordered the item but it seems it cause reaction to my skin. I started getting tiny red papules underneath the eyes every time I used it and I never applied under eyes to begin with. Also didn’t see any change in my skin instead I started getting more pimples.

extraits.titre: Yeah the hype is worth it!
extraits.texte: Okay... i get why so many people love this. I am very pale like ivory skin that shows my redness very easily. After turning 34 my skin changed from Acne prone & oily to more dehyrdated so i have focused more on anti-aging, inner hydration, barrier repair & calming. I bought this on prime week and I am so glad I did. I always wanted to try this after seeing so many reviews and my skin loves pdrn. Right away the serum is very light and sinks in quickly. The affects are subtly but over time with more use you'll see better and stronger results. After a few weeks my skin texture and pores look way better and soft. This serum will now be a staple in my skincare.

This really works for face smoothing. I am a woman in my fifties with some sagging, dark spots and uneven tone in a few spots. I use this daily and my face looks incredibly smooth, like glass. I noticed a difference after the first application. I will admit to not having tried any comparisons but I don’t feel the need. After using this product daily for 2+ months, there is no sign of increased elasticity to help with sagging, even with micro needling. It’s okay, I’m realistic. Yes, I will continue to use this product, it makes me happy to look in the mirror.

at first i was skeptical for buying an pretty expensive product for skincare but i already noticed a difference after day 1. my face feels much smoother, hydrated and it leaves a nice glow. I tried medicube pink peptide serum with salmon dna and that caused irritation and redness on my skin. however, this product leaves no irritation at all. this product will definitely be in rotation for my skincare!

extraits.titre: Instant Hydration & Repair! Love This Ampoule
extraits.texte: I was initially drawn to this product because it claimed to help reset the skin’s regeneration cycle. My skin barrier had been completely compromised uneven texture, dull tone, and excessive dryness. At one point, I even avoided washing my face, and when it felt unbearably dry, I overloaded it with moisture, which only led to more breakouts and an endless cycle of skin issues. That’s when I decided to try this ampoule. The texture is quite thick, even more so than a serum, so it might feel heavy when spreading it on the skin. However, it absorbs well when gently patted in. There’s barely any noticeable scent, which I appreciate. Rather than applying a large amount at once, I found that evenly pressing it into the skin worked best. I’ve been using it for nearly two weeks now, which is a bit short to fully experience the 28-day skin regeneration cycle. However, I can already see and feel a difference! Honestly, my skin has recovered so much it’s unbelievable. I’m now at a point where I only need to use it every 2–3 days. My skin barrier feels significantly stronger! The first night I applied it, I woke up the next morning and could immediately feel the difference. It was so effective that I recommended it to a friend, and after just one use, they asked me what it was because they noticed a visible improvement. Highly recommend this product!

I have dry, cranky, mature skin. Even in my normally humid climate, my skin always feels dry. This serum really helps with that. I've been using it under my moisturizer and it's been making my skin feel so much better. My moisturizer seems to be able to do it's job better and longer. You get 3 bottles of serum in the package, so it'll last me a while. Instead of the usual dropper, it has a syringe like dispenser. It works fine to dispense, but personally I prefer a dropper. Applying it on slightly damp skin helps it spread and a full syringe will cover my entire face when I apply it that way. It's loaded with antioxidants plus the must-have hyaluronic acid and loads of ingredients to help my skin feel smoother and moisturized while being non-irritating. My skin feels soft, supple, and moisturized for hours before I start to feel a bit dry again. Super happy with Rejuran Healer Turnover Ampoule.

Living in Arizona, I’ve struggled a lot with dry skin. I’ve tried so many products to keep my skin hydrated and dewy, and this one has been the absolute best. The texture is somewhere between thick and sticky — like a rich ampoule — but it absorbs quickly into the skin. I apply it and then layer a generous amount of moisturizer on top before bed, and by the next morning, my skin feels soft, hydrated, and smooth. I’ve even noticed an improvement in skin texture and a reduction in dark spots. I’ve been using it for over a week now, mostly on my face and neck, and it’s kind of amazing. I can actually see my neck lines getting lighter. 100% satisfied. Definitely planning to keep using it!
